what_happened.line: The ad hoc Open Space Committee held a public input session on updating the town's open space and recreation plan, which expired in 2016; no votes were taken.
The committee presented town survey results, which came from surveys mailed with tax bills.
Resource maps and the land inventory were presented to show what the updated plan would build on.
Open discussion covered sidewalks, walking and biking maps, review of town-owned land, forest management and recreation, with no resolution.
Residents were invited to send further comments by email to the presenter or through Bernie for forwarding.

why_it_matters: An approved open space plan is what makes the town eligible for state open space and recreation grant reimbursement, so the expired plan leaves that money out of reach for land purchases and recreation projects.
The plan will shape how town-owned land is used, including recreation sites and forest management on conservation land, and residents can still send comments.
watch_next: Further public comments by email to the presenter or through Bernie, as invited at the end of the session.
Whether a local farm map is added to the plan, if the Agricultural Commission and business association want one.
